title: Arriving in Manila on December 23rd
summary: They reach hot Manila, are billeted, and play around the area and at Batangas.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: We caught a plane out of Guam. That's a long flight from Guam down to Manila. We arrived in Manila, it was hot as -- it was hot, wasn't it, Charles?
The sun was -- man, it was hot weather, man.

Hot, man, so we -- they were waiting for us. And they took us somewhere in that town to billet And after we were there a couple of days, they started booking us out to different places to play. And we played the whole area of Manila and we went to one little town called Batangas.
